notes.title: Bacon Rebellion Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello!
If you liked any of my previous games, I thought to let you know that my newest game - Bacon Rebellion is out now!
It's a small and silly top-down shooter game about angry rampaging pigs. Grab your shotgun and put an end to this Bacon Rebellion!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/415780/Bacon_Rebellion/

notes.title: The Inner Darkness - released
notes.content:
Hey guys!

If you enjoyed Moustache Mountain or any other of my games, you should know that I just released my newest game The Inner Darkness.
It is a mysterious puzzle platformer with a dimension switching mechanic.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/562160/

It's right now on a 20% launch discount too. Anyway, check it out!

Thanks a lot!

Nauris

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

It's been a long time since any updates.

I tweaked the level design in some places, particularly those hard 'overhang ledge' jumps(level 6 and others) that only few people seemed to be able to do. I removed them completely and changed them with a different kind of jump, hopefully that helps make the game less frustrating for some of you who really didn't like that jump.

Also added a couple more level variations for the first few levels.

And made a few small visual tweaks. 

I decided to not reset the game leaderboards, as the tweaks aren't so big that they would change leaderboard times considerably. 

Anyway, hope you like this little update!

Thanks,
Nauris

notes.title: The Dark Within
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

My newest game [b]The Dark Within is now on Greenlight![/b]
I would really appreciate if you could check it out!

If you liked any of my previous games I think you might enjoy this one too!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=770836638

P.S To those who are interested in Bacon Rebellion, the game has not been cancelled, I am still working on it, and it's not far from finished. The Dark Within, is just a smaller side-project I worked on!


[b]Thank you, 
Nauris[/b]

notes.title: Local Co-op mode is here!
notes.content:
Hey!

I've just set the new Local co-op mode update live! 
You can now play the game with your friend! And see once and for all which one of you is the fastest to the top of the mountain! Hope you guys enjoy!

There are also a few other minor fixes made in particularly unfair level design and fixed a few reported bugs, like the 'So close, yet so far' achievevement not being awarded to some people who die on the last level.

Thanks for playing everyone,

Nauris

notes.title: Small hotfix update!
notes.content:
Hey!

Just set a small hotfix live with a few fixes -

The level 6 cliff jump has been made a little easier.
You now keep running if the button is held and move to next level.
Small tweaks in other levels.
Made text in highscore tables smaller, so names dont go out of bounds.
And some other small tweaks.

notes.title: Price tag change and new plans!
notes.content:
Hello!

I've thought about the game, and decided that I will change the price point to 2$ instead of 1$. My reason behind this is, that I've had new ideas of what to do with the game later on instead of leaving it as is. 
I have planned some updates, with new Local Co-op game mode where you can race with other players to the top of the mountain and a few other things that will greatly increase the amount of content for the game!

I hope you are not disappointed, as in the end it will only give you a better and more feature-full game. :)

Thanks, 

Nauris
